summary: Stabilization pass for Balaji Convent Fee Software (feature-complete publish candidate). Full backend RBAC + CRUD sweep (47 tests: auth×4 roles, receipts, refunds, debit-vouchers, adjustments, extensions, reminders, cancel/reprint, audit, receipt-types PIN-gated CRUD, config backup/PIN, bus-routes, day-end, defaulters, kiosk/public lookups, static offline assets, manifest, PIN set/verify, settings, fee-structures, imports history, notices). Frontend smoke-navigated 23 authenticated routes as admin + RBAC-verified cashier hides Receipt Types/Config/Admin/Settings + kiosk public /parent/:adm rendered family ledger without auth. Fixed 1 real frontend regression: /reports page threw uncaught ReferenceError 'load is not defined' on mount (Reports.js:20 called undefined load() instead of run()). Backend and 22 of 23 authenticated routes render clean after fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Component crashed on mount with ReferenceError 'load is not defined' — Reports.js line 20 useEffect called load() but only run() exists. FIXED by renaming call to run().

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Emergent visual-editor auto-injects <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <select><option>{d.name}</option></select> for departments (Finance.js:83) and cashiers (DayEnd.js:66). Cosmetic dev-only warning; renders fine in the browser but pollutes console. Suggest suppressing x-ve wrap on option children or using plain text expression.

Sidebar 'Dashboard' link points to '/' (works) but there is NO defined route for '/dashboard' — deep links or bookmarks to /dashboard render an empty Layout shell. Consider adding <Route path='/dashboard' element={<Navigate to='/' />} /> or use /dashboard as the canonical path.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Add a route alias so /dashboard → / redirects (avoids blank page on deep-link).
(OPTIONAL) Suppress Emergent visual-editor <span data-ve-dynamic> injection inside <option> tags in Finance.js and DayEnd.js to silence the React hydration warning.
Main agent may self-verify /reports now loads: log in as admin and open /reports — page must render date pickers + KPI cards without a page-error boundary being tripped.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2095 lines — long overdue for router/service split (dashboards, receipts, receipt-types, adjustments, extensions, kiosk each deserve their own router file).

Departments' academic_year was mutated to '2027-28' by a prior rollover invocation from a previous test run — leftover test state. Not an app bug, but tests that assert year prefix must derive it from the dept doc (already fixed here).
Reports.js had an obviously dead call (load()) — suggests missing lint/type-check step in the build pipeline. Consider re-enabling eslint no-undef in CI.

Two more <option> render sites (Finance dept select, DayEnd cashier select) both trigger the same hydration warning — a single central Select component or a small helper `<Option value={x} label={y} />` would eliminate the class of issue.

Frontend /reports had a crash regression that was fixed in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Frontend /reports crash: Reports.js line 20 had a call to load() left over from a refactor where the fetch helper was renamed to run(). React error boundary caught the ReferenceError, unmounted the tree, and rendered an empty page inside Layout. Fix: change the initial useEffect to invoke run() instead. No API/data change needed. Verified /reports now renders KPI cards and department dropdown after admin login.
